persona: Senior developer who has run Scrum for their team, moving into a full-time Scrum Master role
resumeText:
Meera Joshi | Bengaluru | meera.joshi@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer, Ulsoor Retail Tech, Bengaluru (2019 - present)
- Ran daily stand-ups, sprint planning and retrospectives for a team of 8 for the last two years.
- Maintain the team's Jira board and share sprint velocity in each sprint review.
- Chase blockers with other teams so stories close within the sprint.
- Work with product, design and QA leads to plan monthly releases.
- Build checkout APIs in Java and Spring Boot.

EDUCATION
BE Computer Science, RV College of Engineering, 2019

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Scrum Alliance, 2025
